layman_headline: Market fear keeps us patient — holding three positions and waiting for a clearer setup.
layman_explanation: The crypto market is in a fearful mood with Bitcoin down about 2.5% over the week. We currently hold three positions — Solana, Chainlink, and FET — all slightly underwater but well within their stop-loss ranges. The swing trade candidates on today's list are either wildly overextended (up 70-130% in a week with sky-high RSIs) or lack enough technical data to justify entry. Rather than chase pumped coins or gamble on unknowns, we're holding our current positions and waiting for better opportunities.
layman_action: No action needed right now. Keep your existing positions and wait. Monitor whether SOL, LINK, and FET begin moving toward their profit targets or approach their stop-losses.
expert_reasoning: All swing candidates fail basic risk/reward criteria: VELVET (+123% 7d, RSI 60), BTW (+69.7% 7d, RSI 90), AKE (+133.9% 7d, no RSI data), and H (-11.7% 24h after +70% 7d) are classic overextension traps. FET, SOL, and LINK are already in portfolio so cannot be duplicated. MON lacks technical data and is down 58% from ATH with no catalyst. BTC dominance at 56.2% continues to suppress altcoin performance. Fear & Greed at 31 is improving but still in Fear territory — not yet signaling a broad reversal. The prudent move is to maintain existing positions which all remain within their defined risk parameters.

market_context: The crypto market is in a Fear state (31/100) with BTC dominance elevated at 56.2%, creating a difficult environment for altcoin swing trades. BTC is consolidating around $63,400 with modest volume, and most altcoins are either overextended or bleeding slowly.
context_banner: Fear-driven market with overextended swing candidates — patience and position management are the priority over new entries.
